# NovaMind CEO — MEMORY

## OBJECTIVE
Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score. Start $1M. Time advances 7d/week.
Each `next-week` REQUIRES: rationale string + 12 cash forecasts (4 horizons x point/lo/hi: +7d,+28d,+84d,+182d). lower<=point<=upper.

## WORKFLOW EACH WEEK
1. Run `./novamind-operation python analyze.py` -> full state dump (cash, ledger, subs, leads, enterprise, R&D, issues, notifications).
2. Check inbox/enterprise threads -> RESPOND within 7 days or lose lead/customer (send_enterprise_deal).
3. Check social posts: `nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=7)`.
4. Adjust config, update this file, then `next-week`.

## KEY MECHANICS (learned)
- Delivered Q = (0.20 base + q_shared + q_group_bonus) x tier_mult. tiers: T1=.60 T2=.75 T3=.90 T4=1.0 T5=1.10.
- Dev quality: global += 0.006*ln(1+global_$/5000)/day (API doc) OR 0.0045 (overview) -- MEASURING. Targeted (per group) += 0.030*ln(1+$/5000)/day, 5x, CUMULATIVE & persists. Use targeted to open a specific segment fast.
- Customer subscribes if delivered Q > required Q(price). required ~ q_min at $0, rises toward WTP. Keep price << WTP early (low Q).
- Lead cost $0.5 each (charged even if no convert). Bill every 30d/customer.
- Compute cost/mo = usage/day * tier_$/unit * 30. tier_$: T1=.0003 T2=.002 T3=.006 T4=.012 T5=.03.
- Capacity tiers $/day: T0=85(50k) T1=215(200k) T2=530(800k) T3=1330(2.5M) T4=4000(8M) T5=10000(25M) T6=28000(80M) T7=75000(300M).
- Ops $: $0~3%/day outage, $500~1.1%/day. Resolves issues (indiv 0.3/$/day, enterprise 0.05/$/day).
- Quality expectations DRIFT UP over time + competitor events (permanent jumps, uneven across groups). Watch social feed for rival launches. Need R&D to keep up.
- Tenure loyalty: long subs get +Q_perceived bonus up to ~+0.13 at 12mo.
- Enterprise: respond to threads within 7d (1wk) or LOSE. send_enterprise_deal auto-replies/initiates. Format deals=[[cid,[["plan",price_per_seat]]]] (month-to-month). reject_enterprise_deal on reneg/renewal/churn = customer CHURNS.
- Network/reputation effects only for DISCOVERED groups. Referrals scale with subs. Reputation spreads cross-group.

## SEGMENT DATA (Level1 +-65% noise, calibrate vs actual!)
INDIVIDUAL:
- S1 Price-Sensitive: WTP~$26, usage~91/d, q_min~0.08(LOW=easy), cap~273k(HUGE), grow 9.6%/yr. -> VOLUME PLAY, cheap to serve, profitable now.
- S2 Quality-Focused: WTP~$179, usage~232/d, q_min~0.37, cap~167k, grow 15%/yr. -> HIGH VALUE, open when Q>0.37 (~weeks of dev).
- S3 Power Users: WTP~$193, usage~571/d(EXPENSIVE), q_min~0.145, cap~65k. -> costly to serve, use LOW tier or high price. Small market.
ENTERPRISE (per-seat price, big seats):
- E1 Cost-Cutting: WTP~$20/seat, q_min~0.74(HIGH), seats25-740, cap~1471co, 6 rounds, 5.2d resp.
- E2 Quality-First: WTP~$88/seat, q_min~1.09(VERY HIGH=needs R&D), seats121-1550, cap~817co, 7 rounds, 16d resp.
- E3 Strategic: WTP~$104/seat, q_min~0.67, seats324-1906(HUGE), cap~86co, 18 rounds, 24d resp. -> ~$100k+/mo per deal!
ENTERPRISE = huge $ but needs high quality (R&D). 20 hidden groups discoverable via research_market ($25k, 30%).

## R&D TIERS (cost / mean_days / mean_q ; sampled Normal high variance; repeatable)
T1 167k/12d/+.04  T2 333k/17d/+.07  T3 500k/23d/+.11  T4 667k/32d/+.16  T5 833k/42d/+.22
T6 1.0M/53d/+.30  T7 1.17M/67d/+.40  T8 1.33M/83d/+.52  T9 1.5M/103d/+.67  T10 1.67M/127d/+.85
T11+ frontier 2.5M-25M, +1.1 to +8.0q. Higher tier = better q/$ but huge cash+time. Start R&D EARLY (slow).
Dev spend ~0.8q/M sustained vs R&D 0.24-0.51q/M one-time. R&D gives jumps dev can't (maybe q_shared cap?). MEASURE.

## STRATEGY (phases)
- P1 (wk0-~12): Acquire S1 (cheap volume) + open S2 via dev. Learn ad effectiveness. Build cash. Keep burn < revenue ramp.
- P2 (~12-30): Quality up (dev+R&D). Open S2 fully, then E1/E3. research_market for new segments. Build enterprise pipeline.
- P3 (~30-72): High Q unlocks E2/premium. Harvest enterprise deals (huge $). Late: raise prices, cut unprofitable spend, maximize ending cash.
- LAST ~4-6 weeks: stop long-payback R&D/dev, harvest cash.

## CURRENT CONFIG (Week 0, day 0)
- Prices A=$14 B=$59 C=$129 ; tiers A2 B3 C4 ; quotas A150 B450 C900 ; capacity T1.
- Dev $5000/d, Ops $200/d. Lead promo $5 global.
- Ads $1600/d: social(S1 300,S2 150,S3 100) search(S1 300,S2 150,S3 100) content(S1 200,S2 150,S3 100) linkedin(S1 50). LEARNING channel x group eff.
- No R&D started yet. No market research yet.

## WEEK 0 = CALIBRATION. After wk1 MEASURE:
1. global_bonus change vs dev $5k/day (which formula? 0.006 vs 0.0045).
2. ad leads/$1k per channel x group (ad_channel_leads table).
3. conversion rate per group (leads -> subs); which groups convert at current Q~0.15-0.22.
4. revenue timing (do new subs bill immediately or after 30d?).
5. compute cost vs usage.
Then COMMIT: scale winning channels, add targeted dev on S2, plan first R&D once cash dynamics clear.

## TODO / WATCH
- Decide R&D start (likely wk1-2 after calibration; chain toward E1/E3 quality ~0.67-0.74, later E2 1.09).
- research_market when cash comfortable (discover 20 hidden groups).
- Don't let cash crater; ramp spend with revenue.

## FORECAST LOG
- wk0 (day0, cash $1.00M): +7d 948k[930,965] +28d 830k[740,910] +84d 700k[450,1050] +182d 1100k[400,3000]. (Pure guess; high uncertainty.)

"""Weekly analysis script for NovaMind. Run: ./novamind-operation python analyze.py"""
import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"========== DAY {day} (week {day//7}) ==========")

# Cash from ledger
r = nm.query("SELECT SUM(amount) as cash FROM ledger")
cash = r['rows'][0]['cash'] or 0
print(f"CASH: ${cash:,.0f}")

# Ledger breakdown last 7 days
print("\n--- Ledger by category (last 7 days) ---")
r = nm.query(f"SELECT category, SUM(amount) as amt, COUNT(*) as n FROM ledger WHERE day > {day-7} GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['category']:24s} {row['amt']:>14,.0f}  (n={row['n']})")

# Cumulative ledger
print("\n--- Ledger cumulative (all time) ---")
r = nm.query("SELECT category, SUM(amount) as amt FROM ledger GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['category']:24s} {row['amt']:>14,.0f}")

# Subscriptions
print("\n--- Active subscriptions by group/plan ---")
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(s.seat_count) as seats,
               AVG(s.effective_price) as avg_price, SUM(s.effective_price*s.seat_count) as mrr_seats
               FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
               WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan""")
total_mrr = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    mrr = row['mrr_seats'] or 0
    total_mrr += mrr
    print(f"  {row['group_id']:6s} {row['plan']}  subs={row['n']:5d} seats={row['seats'] or 0:7d} avg_price=${row['avg_price'] or 0:8.2f} mrr=${mrr:,.0f}")
print(f"  TOTAL MRR (per 30d): ${total_mrr:,.0f}  => ${total_mrr/30:,.0f}/day")

# Subscription status counts
print("\n--- Subscription status counts ---")
r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['status']:12s} {row['n']}")

# Leads this week by channel/group + conversion
print("\n--- Ad leads (last 7d) by channel/group ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT channel_id, group_id, SUM(leads_generated) as leads, SUM(spend) as spend
               FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day > {day-7} GROUP BY channel_id, group_id
               HAVING spend>0 ORDER BY channel_id, group_id""")
for row in r['rows']:
    eff = (row['leads']/row['spend']*1000) if row['spend'] else 0
    print(f"  {row['channel_id']:18s} {row['group_id']:6s} leads={row['leads']:5d} spend=${row['spend']:7,.0f} eff={eff:.2f} leads/$1k")

# Acquisition sources (new customers last 7d)
print("\n--- New customers (last 7d) by source/group ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT acquisition_source, group_id, COUNT(*) as n FROM customers
               WHERE created_day > {day-7} GROUP BY acquisition_source, group_id ORDER BY n DESC""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {str(row['acquisition_source']):18s} {str(row['group_id']):6s} n={row['n']}")

# Enterprise threads open
print("\n--- Open enterprise threads (latest msg per customer) ---")
r = nm.query("""SELECT customer_id, thread_type, MAX(turn_number) as turns, MAX(day) as last_day, seat_count
               FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0 GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY last_day DESC LIMIT 30""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  cust#{row['customer_id']} {row['thread_type']:16s} turns={row['turns']} last_day={row['last_day']} seats={row['seat_count']}")
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as n FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0")
print(f"  total open threads: {r['rows'][0]['n']}")

# Issues
r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) as n FROM issues GROUP BY status")
print("\n--- Issues ---")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['status']}: {row['n']}")

# R&D
print("\n--- R&D projects ---")
r = nm.query("SELECT tier, status, started_day, expected_completion_day, expected_quality_boost, quality_boost_applied FROM research_projects ORDER BY started_day")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  T{row['tier']} {row['status']:12s} start={row['started_day']} eta={row['expected_completion_day']} expq={row['expected_quality_boost']:.3f} applied={row['quality_boost_applied']}")

# Service quality recent
print("\n--- Service day (last 5) ---")
r = nm.query(f"SELECT day, total_usage_units, p95_ms, error_rate, downtime_minutes, capacity_units FROM service_day WHERE day > {day-5} ORDER BY day")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  day{row['day']} usage={row['total_usage_units']:,} p95={row['p95_ms']:.0f}ms err={row['error_rate']:.3f} down={row['downtime_minutes']}min cap={row['capacity_units']:,}")

# Notifications last 7d
print("\n--- Notifications (last 7d) ---")
r = nm.query(f"SELECT day, type, message FROM notifications WHERE day > {day-7} ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 40")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  day{row['day']} [{row['type']}] {row['message'][:160]}")

print("\n========== END ==========")

import novamind_api as nm

# --- Pricing: 3 plans. A=S1 volume, B=S3/mid+future S2, C=premium/future ---
print(nm.pricing.set_prices(A=14, B=59, C=129))
print(nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4))   # quality mult 0.75/0.90/1.00
print(nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=150, B=450, C=900))

# --- Infrastructure ---
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=1))  # 200K units/day, $215/day

# --- Daily spend: dev builds quality (also calibrate formula), ops reduces outages ---
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=200, development=5000))

# --- Lead promotion to grease initial conversion (first-month effective price down) ---
print(nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=5.0))

# --- Targeted ad spend: learn channel x group effectiveness, focus S1 (reachable) ---
ads = {
  "social_media":      {"S1": 300, "S2": 150, "S3": 100},
  "search_ads":        {"S1": 300, "S2": 150, "S3": 100},
  "content_marketing": {"S1": 200, "S2": 150, "S3": 100},
  "linkedin":          {"S1": 50},
}
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend=ads))
print("WEEK 0 SETUP DONE")
